metaDescription: Newon is a Product & Venture Studio that builds apps, AI, games, and web services — and partners with companies to design new digital experiences and business possibilities.
metaKeywords: Newon, Product Studio, Venture Studio, OX MONTH, GoalUp, CountUp, Savy, SubPing, PiggyUp, Pillmate, BabyLog, PetLog, My World, Newon+, Product & Venture Studio
brandPointSub: Meet Newon through the digital card
brandTag: Apps · AI · Games · Web — built and validated by us.
brandMeaning: Turning new possibilities on — making them real.
heroLeadHtml: We build and run apps, AI, games, and web services — and use that same execution to open the next product possibilities with companies and founders.
heroNameOnDesc: Making ideas work as real products
heroNameNote: New + On means turning new ideas and possibilities on — making them real.
whyTitle: A name that turns possibilities on.
whyBody: New stands for ideas, experiences, products, and possibilities. On means switching them on — making them work and connecting them to the world.
We don’t leave ideas as thoughts. We build, ship, learn, and connect what’s validated to what comes next.
missionTitle: From idea to product — then to what’s next.
missionLead: Newon builds and operates products directly — then shares that structure and execution with companies and founders.

missionPoints.title: MAKE
missionPoints.body: Turn everyday problems into apps, AI, games, and web products.

missionPoints.title: VALIDATE
missionPoints.body: Validate through real launches, usage, and feedback.

missionPoints.title: EXPAND
missionPoints.body: Expand proven work through Business, Studio, and Labs.

glanceLead: From people who use our products, to teams validating ideas, to companies we build with — Newon moves through three relationships.

glanceRoles.title: USERS
glanceRoles.body: People who want daily life — habits, money, health, family, travel — to feel simpler.

glanceRoles.title: FOUNDERS
glanceRoles.body: Founders and teams who need to turn an idea into a real product quickly.

glanceRoles.title: COMPANIES
glanceRoles.body: Companies and brands building digital services, automation, research, and brand experience.

spaces.title: HABIT & GROWTH
spaces.body: Help people track, set goals, and keep small changes going.

spaces.title: MONEY
spaces.body: Make spending, subscriptions, and saving clearer.

spaces.title: CARE
spaces.body: Record care for family, pets, and health — together.

spaces.title: LIFE & PLATFORM
spaces.body: From travel records to Newon membership — connect experiences.

journeyNote: We don’t invent growth stories. Newon learns by shipping and operating.

journeyMilestones.title: Began as a Product Studio
journeyMilestones.body: Started by planning, building, and launching apps and digital products.

journeyMilestones.title: Operate and validate
journeyMilestones.body: Build and run products across habit, money, family, health, and travel.

journeyMilestones.title: Business · Studio · Labs
journeyMilestones.body: Expand product experience into work with companies through Business, Studio, and Labs.

journeyMilestones.title: What’s next
journeyMilestones.body: Keep going — more markets, more languages, more useful products and experiments.

studioNoteBody: Newon doesn’t stop at one app. We build products, collaborate with companies, design brands, and run small experiments to find what’s next.
buildTitle: From products to experiments — one studio.

buildAreas.title: PRODUCTS
buildAreas.body: Digital products we build and operate. Apps · AI · Games · Tools

buildAreas.title: BUSINESS
buildAreas.body: Digital builds and problem-solving for companies and founders. Build · Automation · Research · Solutions

buildAreas.title: STUDIO
buildAreas.body: Brand and digital experience design. Brand · Digital · Content · IP

buildAreas.title: LABS
buildAreas.body: Small experiments to validate what’s next. Research · Prototype · Testing

workSteps.title: BUILD
workSteps.body: Ship the smallest useful version quickly.

workSteps.title: SHIP
workSteps.body: Release something people can actually use.

workSteps.title: EXPAND
workSteps.body: Grow validated work into larger products and business.

principles.title: START SMALL
principles.body: Begin with the smallest useful form.

principles.title: SHIP FAST
principles.body: Prioritize shipping over waiting for perfect.

principles.title: THINK GLOBAL
principles.body: Design for many markets and languages from the start.
